criteria.turn_away: End the interview by refusing entry when there is insufficient confidence for release, but no established crime. At the last turn make a final decision.
criteria.release: Release when papers and explanations account for observed facts without a specific unresolved contradiction. Valid seal, packaging explaining mass, and an operational component explaining warmth are sufficient grounds. Certainty is not required. Do not ask irrelevant questions or search merely because a plausible account might be a lie. A convincing liar can pass.
